import warnings
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.multioutput import MultiOutputClassifier
import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

TARGETS = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]


def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return text.lower().replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", " ").strip()
    return ""


print("Loading datasets...")
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

print("Preprocessing text...")
df_train["text"] = df_train["comment_text"].apply(clean_text)
df_test["text"] = df_test["comment_text"].apply(clean_text)

X = df_train["text"].values
y = df_train[TARGETS].values
X_test = df_test["text"].values

# Strict hold-out split for validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

# Feature extraction using character n-grams (highly effective for toxicity detection)
print("Vectorizing text with TF-IDF...")
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(3, 6),
    max_features=40000,
    min_df=3,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
X_train_vec = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_vec = tfidf.transform(X_val)
X_test_vec = tfidf.transform(X_test)

# Base LightGBM configuration
base_lgb = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    objective="binary",
    metric="auc",
    boosting_type="gbdt",
    n_estimators=300,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    max_depth=-1,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    force_row_wise=True,
)

# Wrap for multi-label support
model = MultiOutputClassifier(base_lgb, n_jobs=-1)

# Validation phase: train strictly on hold-out set
print("Training on validation split and computing metric...")
model.fit(X_train_vec, y_train)
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_vec)
val_auc_array = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs, average=None)
val_mean_auc = np.mean(val_auc_array)
print(f"Validation Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {val_mean_auc:.4f}")

# Final training on full labeled data for submission
print("Retraining on full dataset for final submission...")
X_all_vec = tfidf.fit_transform(X)
model_final = MultiOutputClassifier(base_lgb, n_jobs=-1)
model_final.fit(X_all_vec, y)

# Generate test predictions
print("Predicting on test set...")
test_probs = model_final.predict_proba(X_test_vec)

# Assemble submission file
submission = df_test[["id"]].copy()
for i, col in enumerate(TARGETS):
    submission[col] = test_probs[:, i]

sub_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission.to_csv(sub_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission successfully saved to {sub_path}")
